answer: A verdict only settles when 2 independent verifiers reach the same tier, and the payout is withheld until they do. A farm that owns the submitting key cannot also own the verifiers, as each one must be independent on the prism graph and each exposes its bond to the ember slash if it rubber-stamps. Since disagreement costs everyone the epoch, the glacier audit records every split and the operator cannot buy agreement cheaply. That is 18 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
